manifest.description: Fills job application forms from your %BRAND% profile. You check every answer and submit the application yourself.

panel.title: Fill this form
panel.pageByPage: This form has several pages. Fill each page, then use the form's own button to go on.
panel.oneFill: The whole application uses 1 form fill.
panel.newPage: You're on a new page of this form.
panel.newPageNoCost: It's the same application, so it uses no extra form fill.
panel.noFields: No fields found on this page. Scroll to the form, or open the application page, then try again.
panel.undoPartial: {count} choices can't be undone here. Change them on the form.
panel.submitYourself: Check the form, then submit it yourself.

connect.title: Connect your account
connect.body: Connect %BRAND% to fill forms with your profile.

fit.note: This is not your chance of getting hired.

note.protected: Answer this one yourself. Drafts are never written for questions like this.
note.no_value: Your profile doesn't have this yet.
note.no_option: None of the choices matched your profile. Pick one yourself.
note.not_pressed: This choice needs a click on the form. Pick it yourself.
note.resume_unavailable: Your resume couldn't be loaded. Attach it yourself.
note.cover_letter: Attach a cover letter yourself, or write one in %BRAND% first.
note.file_failed: The file couldn't be attached. Attach it yourself.
note.disabled: This field is locked on the form.
note.undone: Put back the way it was.
note.ai_unavailable: Drafts aren't available for your account right now.
note.draft_failed: The draft couldn't be written. Try again or answer it yourself.

item.checkSensitive: Sensitive answer. Check it before you submit.

draft.aiLabel: Written by AI. Edit it, then use it only if it's true for you.
draft.aiDisclosure: This text was generated by an AI model.
draft.saveHint: Next time, forms with this question are filled from your saved answers.
draft.saveFailed: This answer couldn't be saved. Try again.
draft.saveProtected: Answers about you are kept in your profile, not here.

error.credits_exhausted: You've used your form fills for now.
error.credits_exhaustedUntil: You've used your form fills for now. More on {time}.
error.feature_disabled: Form filling isn't available for your account.
error.not_connected: Connect %BRAND% first. Open %BRAND%, then try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
error.network: Can't reach %BRAND% right now. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was submitted. Try again.

submitted.question: Did you submit this application?
submitted.thanks: Moved to Applied in your applications.
submitted.thanksNoJob: Thanks. Add it to your applications in %BRAND%.
submitted.later: When you submit it, mark it as applied in your applications.

popup.title: %BRAND%
popup.reconnectBody: This browser was disconnected from your account. Connect it again to keep filling forms.
popup.codeInvalid: That code doesn't work. Codes have 8 letters or numbers and expire after 10 minutes.
popup.boardBody: Job on {site}. Nothing on this page is read until you choose an action.
popup.saved: Saved to your jobs. Only you can see it.
popup.noFit: No fit for this job yet. Open it in %BRAND% to see one.
popup.noJobFound: No job found on this page.
popup.openFormSite: On {site}, open the application form, then choose Fill this form.
popup.plannedSite: Forms on {site} can't be filled yet.
popup.otherSite: Forms on this site can't be filled yet.

modes.heading: How to fill
modes.allHint: Fills every field your profile can answer.
modes.blankHint: Leaves fields that already have something in them.
modes.selectionHint: Select part of the form on the page first.
modes.again: Fill again, for example on the next step of the form
modes.cost: Filling the same page again uses no extra form fill.

note.has_value: Already filled on the form. Left as it is.
note.personal: Personal detail. Fill it in yourself.
note.family_none: Add family members to your profile (optional), or fill this in yourself.
note.sensitive_consent: Your optional details are used only after you turn on filling them in settings. Or fill this in yourself.
note.other_person: This asks about someone else. Fill it in yourself.
note.check_whose: This may be about someone else. Check and fill it in yourself.
note.photo: Attach a photo yourself if the form asks for one.

error.no_selection: Select part of the form on the page first, then try again.
error.no_fields_in_selection: No fields in the part you selected. Select more of the form, then try again.

review.title: Check everything, then submit it yourself.
review.found: The form's own submit button is outlined on the page. Nothing has been submitted.
review.notFound: When you finish, use the form's own buttons. Nothing has been submitted.

item.checkSensitive: From your optional details. Check it before you submit.

manifest.description: Fills application forms from your %BRAND% profile. You check every answer and submit the application yourself.
